/-- The maximal number of pointwise linearly independent continuous vector fields on 𝕊ⁿ⁻¹
is ρ(n) - 1. -/
theorem maxNumVecFieldsSphere_eq_radonHurwitz_sub_one (n : ℕ+) :
    maxNumVecFieldsSphere n = radonHurwitz n - 1 := by
  sorry
